survey: Multi-year network roughness (IRI) and rutting trend, DNR/UNRA paved-network field surveys
note: Network-average IRI (m/km) and rutting (mm), computed from per-100m/per-lane raw survey records for each available survey year. 2020-21 has no comparable IRI/rutting dataset in the source repository (visual condition survey only that year) and is shown as a gap, not fabricated. 2025-26 is on Deep Analytics under the separate 2025-26 ROMDAS Field Survey Register / Summary Statistics panel.

years.label: 2018 IRI & Rutting Survey
years.iri_note: 2018 IRI workbook's readings are byte-identical to the 2017-18 survey (same values, only the date/label fields differ) — not an independent re-survey, so IRI is omitted here to avoid double-counting a flat trend point. Rutting below is a distinct dataset.
